journey.name: channels closing notice
journey.description:
Verifies the notice that Synonym is winding down Blocktank (its Lightning service provider) for a user with a Lightning channel (synonymdev/bitkit-ios#1097). Home shows a banner, "CHANNELS CLOSE ON DEC 15, 2026" (id "ChannelsClosingBanner"), tapping it opens the Spending wallet, which shows "Your Lightning channels will be closed on Dec 15, 2026. Move your spending balance to savings before then." (id "ChannelsClosingNotice") under the balance header, and Transfer To Savings (id "TransferToSavings") is still offered. The Savings wallet's Transfer To Spending button (id "TransferToSpending") opens the "Transfer Unavailable" sheet (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") instead of the transfer flow, since new channels can no longer be bought. The date is a placeholder constant until the shutdown date is final; assert whatever date the build shows, and keep the banner and the notice in agreement.
iOS: "Press the system back button" is the navigation bar back button (id "NavigationBack").
Precondition: onboarded regtest wallet with a Lightning channel to the LSP (Blocktank) node, open or pending, and a POSITIVE Spending balance; channels to other nodes do not show the notice. This build cannot buy a channel from Blocktank, so get one by installing a build from before the change (master before synonymdev/bitkit-ios#1097), opening a channel with Transfer To Spending and installing this build over it, or by opening a manual channel to the LSP node (see ../README.md, Getting a Lightning channel). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Verify the Spending balance card (id "ActivitySpending") shows a positive amount

Verify the banner (id "ChannelsClosingBanner") is visible on the home screen with the text "CHANNELS CLOSE ON DEC 15, 2026" and the same style as the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner; note the date it shows
Verify the Spending wallet screen is open, showing the balance (id "TotalBalance-primary"; Android "TotalBalance")
Verify the notice (id "ChannelsClosingNotice") reads "Your Lightning channels will be closed on Dec 15, 2026. Move your spending balance to savings before then." with the same date the banner showed
Verify the "Transfer To Savings" button (id "TransferToSavings") is visible
Press the system back button, then tap the Savings balance card (id "ActivitySavings")
Verify the Savings wallet screen is open, then tap "Transfer To Spending" (id "TransferToSpending")

Verify the sheet (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") opens with the nav title "Transfer Unavailable", the lightning-bolt image (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetImage"), the title "MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED" with "MANUAL SETUP" in purple (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetTitle") and the text "Automatic transfers to your spending balance are no longer available. Use your own node, or set up a connection with another provider." (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetDescription")
Tap "Cancel" (id "ChannelsUnavailableSheetCancel") and verify the sheet closes and the Savings wallet screen is still shown
Press the system back button, tap the Spending balance card (id "ActivitySpending") and verify the notice (id "ChannelsClosingNotice") is still shown
